summary: Learn Revit project setup, architectural modeling, views, schedules and sheets through practical exercises. Explore the course outline and enrol.
lede: Revit architecture training covers setting up an architectural building model and creating coordinated design documentation. It is for beginners, including architectural designers, technicians and BIM modelers who need to produce clear model views and drawings. You will practise setting levels and grids, placing and editing building elements, creating plans and sections, and assembling annotated sheets with schedules.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for beginners who need to create architectural building models and produce dependable views and documentation in Autodesk Revit.
prerequisites: Prior Revit experience is not assumed. You should be comfortable using a computer and managing project files. Coding or programming is not required.
